##### Project general facts

Brabus Island Baku is an exclusive waterfront residential project that brings the iconic Brabus design philosophy to life through bold architecture, refined details, and bespoke luxury. The development offers a diverse collection of residences, including studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and twin villas, creating an exceptional choice for sophisticated modern living.

Residents can enjoy a premium selection of amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and everyday comfort, including a resort-inspired swimming pool, advanced fitness zone, spa with hammams, saunas and massage suites, and an elegant lounge area. Every space is thoughtfully designed to create a private and refined atmosphere where residents can relax, recharge, socialize, and enjoy an elevated lifestyle.

The interiors are inspired by Brabus supercars, combining contemporary luxury, precision craftsmanship, carefully selected materials, and a highly personalized approach to design. Each residence can be transformed into a personal Brabus Masterpiece, while the contemporary architecture features sweeping curves, clean vertical lines, large glazed openings, and a sophisticated dark material palette for a distinctive and truly impressive finish.

##### Location description and benefits

Baku, the vibrant capital of Azerbaijan, offers residents a distinctive blend of modern city life, rich cultural heritage, and beautiful Caspian Sea surroundings. The city is known for its impressive architecture, lively atmosphere, and diverse range of dining, shopping, and entertainment options.

Residents can enjoy convenient access to a wide selection of restaurants, cafés, retail destinations, cultural attractions, and recreational spaces. Well-developed urban infrastructure and a variety of everyday services make Baku a comfortable and dynamic place to live.

With its scenic waterfront, historic Old City, and modern cityscape, Baku provides an appealing environment for both relaxed living and an active lifestyle. The combination of coastal charm, cosmopolitan amenities, and year-round opportunities for leisure makes the city an attractive choice for residents.
